package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    Map<String, String> labels,
    Map<String, Integer> counters,
    Map<String, Object> free,
    Map<String, Object> closed,
    Map<String, Double> patterned,
    Map<String, Object> bare,
    Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> nestedMap,
    Map<String, List<String>> listMap,
    Map<String, Object> withProps
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (Map<String, String>) map.get("labels"),
            (Map<String, Integer>) map.get("counters"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("free"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("closed"),
            (Map<String, Double>) map.get("patterned"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("bare"),
            (Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>>) map.get("nestedMap"),
            (Map<String, List<String>>) map.get("listMap"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("withProps")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("labels", labels);
        map.put("counters", counters);
        map.put("free", free);
        map.put("closed", closed);
        map.put("patterned", patterned);
        map.put("bare", bare);
        map.put("nestedMap", nestedMap);
        map.put("listMap", listMap);
        map.put("withProps", withProps);
        return map;
    }
}
